page.overview:
Who is Bidor Ferrouz's receptionist?

Bidor Ferrouz's receptionist was a female who served Bidor Ferrouz, the Imperial governor of Poln Major in the Candoras sector of the Outer Rim Territories. She admitted the visiting Rebel diplomat Vestin Axlon and Mara Jade, an Imperial agent pretending to be Axlon's assistant, into Ferrouz's office in the Whitestone City palace by pressing a door-release control underneath her desk. During a riot instigated by Warlord Nuso Esva, she was killed along with two guards when mercenaries attacked Ferrouz's office.
